For the Petitioner : Mr. R. S. Mazumdar, Sr. Advocate : Mr. Rohan Mazumdar, Advocate For the State : Mrs. Shweta Singh, A.P.P.

2. The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Namkum P.S. Case No. 55/2024, for the offences registered under Sections 467, 468, 471, 420, 120B, 272 & 273 of the I.P.C. and Sections 47(a)(b)(c), 52(d) and 55 of the Jharkhand Excise Amendment Act, pending in the Court of Sri Mayank Maliyaz, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Ranchi.
3. On 06.02.2024, Namkum police intercepted a Wagonr Car bearing registration no. JH02N-3031 from Namkum Basti.
On search, huge quantity of liquor was recovered from the said vehicle.
The vehicle was also found to be stolen.
4. It was submitted that petitioner was neither apprehended at spot nor anything was recovered from his possession.
It was further submitted that name of the petitioner has transpired in confession of co-accused.

sentences.text: In view of the submissions made above, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Sri Mayank Maliyaz, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Ranchi or his successor in connection with Namkum P.S. Case No. 55/2024.
